name: Neon themes
description: Neon cyberpunk appearance themes for the OpenClaw Control UI: matrix green, ocean blue, retro amber, danger red, and Dracula.

themes.name: Neon Matrix
themes.description: Near-black terminal with matrix-green controls, hot-pink highlights, and IBM Plex Mono throughout.

themes.name: Neon Blue
themes.description: Deep navy ocean rig with electric cyan controls, purple highlights, and monospace type.

themes.name: Neon Amber
themes.description: Retro amber phosphor on warm black with teal highlights and monospace type.

themes.name: Neon Red
themes.description: Danger-mode crimson controls with neon-orange highlights on blood-black surfaces.

themes.name: Neon Dracula
themes.description: The official Dracula palette: green controls, pink highlights, purple-grey surfaces, monospace type.
